how_to_buy: Follow signs to Level B. Buy token at machine or counter, cash THB only. Ride to Phaya Thai, transfer to BTS.
scam_risk_note: None on the train itself. Taxi touts wait at arrivals — ignore them.

how_to_buy: Tang 1, canh Gate 7. Len xe roi tra tien mat cho phu xe, gia dong 60 THB bat ke xuong o dau. Khong mua truoc duoc. Tranh dua to 500/1000 THB.
scam_risk_note: Gia dong, khong the bi chat chem. Rui ro chinh la lo chuyen cuoi luc 20:00.

how_to_buy: Tang 1, quay taxi cong cong giua Gate 4-7. Lay phieu o may tu dong, KHONG di theo nguoi moi chao. Yeu cau bat dong ho.
scam_risk_note: Phu phi san bay 50 THB la HOP LE (theo thong bao Bo GTVT), khong phai chat chem. Phi cao toc ~70 THB khach tu tra tien mat. Chieu 'dong ho hong, di gia tron goi' la lua dao.

how_to_buy: Cai app Grab truoc khi bay, dung tai khoan Viet Nam duoc. Ra diem don Grab rieng cua san bay theo bien chi dan, khong ra quay taxi. Gia hien san trong app truoc khi dat.
scam_risk_note: Gia chot trong app, khong mac ca. Nhung 01:00-04:00 rat kho goi duoc tai xe. Gia dong theo nhu cau nen co the cao hon taxi dong ho vao gio cao diem.

how_to_buy: Dat truoc online (Klook, Trip.com hoac cong ty transfer) truoc ngay bay. Tai xe cam bien ten don tai sanh den. Gia chot truoc, khong phat sinh phi cao toc.
scam_risk_note: Gia co dinh, khong co rui ro chat chem. Doi lai la dat nhat. Dang tien khi di nhom 3-4 nguoi hoac ha canh ban dem.

how_to_buy: Ra Cua so 6, sanh den Terminal 1, tim bien 'BMTA Bus'. Len xe roi tra tien mat truc tiep cho phu xe, gia dong 30 THB bat ke xuong dau. Chuan bi tien le, tranh dua to.
scam_risk_note: Gia dong nen khong the bi chat chem. Cho de hanh ly tren xe han che, gio cao diem co the phai dung suot chang.

how_to_buy: Co skywalk noi thang tu san bay sang ga. Mua token o may tu dong hoac quay co nhan vien, CHI nhan tien mat THB. Quet token o cua soat ve. Ve SRT khong dung duoc cho MRT/BTS - phai mua ve rieng neu di tiep.
scam_risk_note: Gia niem yet, khong co rui ro. Luu y: den Bang Sue van phai doi sang MRT moi vao trung tam.

how_to_buy: Quay taxi o Terminal 1 quoc te tang 1 canh Gate 8, hoac Terminal 2 noi dia canh Gate 15. Lay phieu tai quay, khong di theo nguoi moi chao. Yeu cau bat dong ho.
scam_risk_note: Phu phi san bay 50 THB cong vao dong ho la HOP LE theo thong bao Bo GTVT Thai Lan, khong phai chat chem. Phi duong cao toc khach tu tra tien mat tai tram.

how_to_buy: Mua ở quầy Express Train hoặc máy tự động tại ga sân bay. Máy thường từ chối thẻ nước ngoài — nếu vậy ra quầy thanh toán bằng thẻ. Vé có ghế ngồi cố định, có khoang để vali riêng.
scam_risk_note: Gia niem yet 13.000 KRW tai quay, khoang 11.500 KRW neu mua online truoc. Ve Express dung he thong soat ve rieng - KHONG chuyen tuyen mien phi sang tau thuong. Lo chuyen phai ra quay doi ve va tra phi phat 3.500 KRW.

how_to_buy: Mua token o may tu dong tai ga, hoac quet the T-money. Nen mua the T-money o cua hang tien loi trong san bay truoc - the ngan hang nuoc ngoai khong quet truc tiep duoc o cua soat ve.
scam_risk_note: Gia theo cu ly, toi da khoang 5.350 KRW. Uu diem it ai biet: tau nay dung thang o ga Hongik University, con Express chay qua khong dung - neu o Hongdae thi tau re hon lai tien hon.

how_to_buy: Mua ve o quay hoac kiosk trong sanh den TRUOC khi ra ben - chieu tu san bay KHONG quet T-money len xe duoc. Kiosk nhan the nuoc ngoai. Hanh ly de duoi gam xe, nhan viec xep giup.
scam_risk_note: Gia co dinh 17.000 KRW, khong co rui ro. Rui ro that la tac duong - tranh khung 16:30-19:30. Bu lai xe do ngay truoc nhieu khach san, khong phai keo vali qua cau thang ga tau.

how_to_buy: Ra hang taxi chinh thuc theo bien chi dan o sanh den. Taxi Han Quoc deu bat dong ho, khong mac ca. Nen co san dia chi khach san viet bang tieng Han de dua tai xe xem.
scam_risk_note: Phu phi ban dem toi 40% trong khung 23:00-02:00 la HOP LE, khong phai chat chem. Nhieu tai xe khong noi tieng Anh - chuan bi dia chi bang tieng Han.

how_to_buy: Cai app Kakao T truoc khi bay. App can so dien thoai de xac thuc - nen dang ky truoc khi roi Viet Nam hoac dung eSIM Han Quoc. Ra diem don ride-hail rieng theo bien chi dan.
scam_risk_note: Gia hien trong app truoc khi dat. Phu phi ban dem 23:00-02:00 la hop le. Kho khan chinh la buoc xac thuc so dien thoai - nhieu nguoi nuoc ngoai khong dung duoc app neu chua chuan bi.

how_to_buy: Theo bien 'Train to City', ga MRT o tang ham Terminal 2 va 3. Quet thang bang the Visa/Mastercard khong tiep xuc (SimplyGo), hoac mua the EZ-Link 10 SGD o quay TransitLink. Phai doi tau mot lan tai ga Tanah Merah.
scam_risk_note: Gia niem yet, khong co rui ro. Luu y: Terminal 4 KHONG co ga MRT - phai di xe shuttle mien phi sang Terminal 3 truoc, mat them 15-20 phut.

how_to_buy: Ben xe bus o tang ham Terminal 1, 2, 3. Quet the EZ-Link hoac the ngan hang khong tiep xuc. Neu tra tien mat phai co dung tien le, xe KHONG tra lai tien thua.
scam_risk_note: Gia niem yet. Chi nen di neu khach san nam tren tuyen 36 va hanh ly gon - xe khong co cho de vali.

how_to_buy: Xep hang o quay taxi chinh thuc theo bien chi dan. Tat ca taxi deu bat dong ho, do LTA quan ly. Khong co co tro moi chao.
scam_risk_note: Phu phi san bay 3-5 SGD, phu phi gio cao diem 25%, phu phi dem 00:00-06:00 len toi 50% - tat ca deu HOP LE va cong khai. Ban ngay 28-45 SGD, sau nua dem 35-55 SGD.

how_to_buy: Cai app Grab truoc khi bay, tai khoan Viet Nam dung duoc. Ra diem don ride-hail rieng theo bien chi dan. Gia hien day du truoc khi dat.
scam_risk_note: Gia chot trong app, da bao gom moi phu phi. Nhung tang gia dong khi mua hoac gio cao diem - co the vot len gap doi. Neu thay gia cao, doi 10-15 phut hoac di MRT vao trung tam roi goi Grab chang ngan.
